scripts.android-device-clear: rm -rf ./android && APP_ENV=preview NODE_ENV=development expo run:android --variant release --device
scripts.ios-device-clear: rm -rf ./ios && APP_ENV=preview NODE_ENV=development expo run:ios --device --configuration Release
scripts.build-android-preview: rm -rf android && eas build --platform android --profile preview --local --clear-cache
scripts.build-android-production: rm -rf android && NODE_ENV=production eas build --platform android --profile production --local --clear-cache
scripts.build-ios-preview: rm -rf ios && eas build --platform ios --profile preview --local --clear-cache
scripts.build-ios-production-local: rm -rf ios && NODE_ENV=production eas build --platform ios --profile production --local --clear-cache
scripts.build-ios-production-cloud-submit: rm -rf ios && NODE_ENV=production eas build --platform ios --profile production --auto-submit --clear-cache
scripts.update-ios-production: f(){ export APP_ENV=production NODE_ENV=production; npx expo export --platform ios --output-dir dist/ios-production --clear && eas update --branch production --platform ios --environment production --input-dir dist/ios-production --skip-bundler --message "[ios] $1"; }; f
scripts.update-android-production: f(){ export APP_ENV=production NODE_ENV=production; npx expo export --platform android --output-dir dist/android-production --clear && eas update --branch production --platform android --environment production --input-dir dist/android-production --skip-bundler --message "[android] $1"; }; f
